calendar_rule.verification_status: official_rule_reviewed; ordinary dates remain rule-inferred, not individually verified
calendar_rule.rule: Equities trade all days except Saturdays, Sundays and holidays declared by the Exchange in advance.
calendar_rule.limitation: A weekly rule and published holiday schedule do not independently attest every individual ordinary session or unannounced disruptions.

limitations: Calendar sessions before 2025 are based on the existing 2O base calendar and its evidence/provenance.
For 2025-10-22 through 2026-10-22 ordinary dates are inferred from the official NSE weekly rule and the verified CM holiday notices; they are not each independently corroborated by daily bhavcopy.
The audit and all observed data are RELIANCE-only and do not establish market-wide coverage or point-in-time universe completeness.
Official calendar evidence cannot establish that a particular security traded; a missing RELIANCE row remains a provider omission or unresolved bar gap.

instrument_coverage.scope_warning: RELIANCE-only evidence does not establish full-market or point-in-time-universe coverage.
